original_test_intent: Verify all physical CPU packages and expected core/thread topology are present with correct model, stepping, socket properties and NVSM health OK.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load expected socket/serial/model/stepping/core/thread/NUMA/property manifest; run exact `nvsm show cpus` read-only; retain raw hierarchy/status/health; compare count, identity/topology and properties, including approved disabled cores; corroborate deviations without changing CPU configuration.
manual_activity: Platform owner supplies CPU/socket/core topology manifest and dispositions every missing, mismatched or non-OK CPU.
safety_requirements: Never clear logs or change CPU online state, power, frequency or firmware

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command is applicable but lacks expected sockets, core topology and properties.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal CPUs command and compare its hierarchy to the approved physical/NUMA manifest.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All CPUs and every health state remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a socket-keyed expected/observed table including model/stepping, cores/threads, NUMA and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes all-CPU correctness deterministic while command-specific.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Processor-object inventory is not assumed schema-equivalent.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware core disablement and SMT policy can legitimately change exposed counts; approved policy is required.

project_override_considerations: Platform recipe owns socket population, SMT/core-disable and NUMA expectations.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target CPU inventory and health; missing reference values are project inputs and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and CPU manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Preserves CPU-specific topology coverage and detects approved versus unintended disabled cores instead of relying on a generic processor count.
independent_technical_reasoning: Package presence alone cannot prove all cores or NUMA nodes are exposed. Socket identity, core/thread counts and NUMA mapping must be compared together because a firmware setting can leave the CPU visible while silently reducing compute topology.
